issue.title: livereload reloads for every file that changes
issue.maintainer_reproduction: touching N Markdown files after initial serve build caused N sequential rebuilds
issue.status_note: The initial --wait attempt was reverted; PR 2385 replaced the server/watcher implementation.

release.release_note: Multiple rapid file changes no longer cause the site to repeatedly rebuild.
release.observer_followup: Version 1.2.2 reverted file watching to a polling observer for virtual filesystems, while retaining the batching server architecture.

scope: The executable replay below runs the exact merged _build_loop from the source snapshot with accepted callbacks injected into its condition queue. It does not instantiate watchdog or build a MkDocs site.
